topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: I can't help but remember the day we painted the clouds pink, laughing until the sky changed its mind. Now, the room feels different, like the walls have grown a shade darker. I see the way the light casts shadows where before there was only warmth. This move, I know it's big, an adventure we've talked about, dreamed of. But the thought of you being just a memory here, a whisper in the wind, it changes the air. I want you to chase your stars, you deserve to catch them, but I'm finding it hard to let go of the skies we built together. Maybe we'll paint different skies from afar, blend our colors through lines and whispers, keep our corner of the world bright even if we're worlds apart.
